title: VASCULAR PULSE
description: An elastic vessel bed carries pressure rather than decorative branches. Drag through it to pump several neighbouring vessels continuously; pulses propagate, recoil moves junctions and repeated flow permanently remodels conductance thickness. Conduction, leak, pump, recoil and remodeling produce visibly different fast, damped, hypertrophic or self-pulsing regimes.

visual_finish.composition: a branching full-frame vessel bed carries bright pressure fronts through a persistent dark-red network with locally remodeled thickness
visual_finish.material_model: deep tissue ground, dark vessels, hot orange arterial flow and small faceted junctions instead of generic point sprites
detail_scales: individual vessel segments and faceted junctions
